bullets.text: Engineered a privacy-first RAG pipeline for NLP documentation across legacy PHP/JS codebases with no code leaving infrastructure: LangChain ingestion, 2,000-character chunking, Linq-Embed-Mistral embeddings in a local Chroma store, and Llama 3 via Ollama; retrieval surrounds each chunk with context, achieving a 90% reduction in manual documentation work.
Developed an automated call-quality assessment tool using WhisperX speech-to-text and rule-based large language models, replacing manual QA audits.
Ran internal workshops on large language models and prompt engineering, accelerating adoption of AI tools across the team.
